query: INSERT INTO kpmr_snapshot (id, fetched_at, source_url, content_hash, etag, format, data, model_count, last_attempt_at) VALUES (1, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fetched_at = $1, source_url = $2, content_hash = $3, etag = $4, format = $5, data = $6, model_count = $7, last_attempt_at = $1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now()
